numbering: Episodes numbered 1-47 in broadcast order as on Wikipedia, ignoring the half-numbered 'Junko's Room' recaps (11.5, 21.5, 36.5).

arcs.name: Two Nanas
arcs.summary: Two 20-year-old women named Nana meet by chance on a train to Tokyo, then the story steps back to show their lives before.
events: Nana Komatsu and Nana Osaki sit together on a snowbound train.
Nana K.'s relationship with Shoji is shown.
Nana O.'s past with Ren and the band Black Stones is revealed.

arcs.name: Room 707
arcs.summary: The two Nanas end up sharing an apartment in Tokyo as Nana O. rebuilds her band.
events: The two move into Room 707 together.
Yasu and Nobu reunite with Nana O., and the young bassist Shin joins the band.
Shoji cheats on Nana K. with his coworker Sachiko.
Blast plays its first live show.

arcs.name: Trapnest
arcs.summary: Nana K.'s love of the band Trapnest pulls both Nanas into its members' lives.
events: Nana O. reunites with Ren at a Trapnest concert.
Nana K. starts a relationship with Trapnest's leader Takumi.
Nana K. becomes torn between Takumi and Nobu.

arcs.name: Hachi's Choice
arcs.summary: An unexpected pregnancy changes Nana K.'s life and her friendship with Nana O.
events: Nana K. discovers she is pregnant.
She chooses to stay with Takumi, hurting Nobu.
The strawberry glasses the Nanas share are broken.

arcs.name: Blast's Debut
arcs.summary: While Nana K. becomes a housewife, Blast finally makes it to a major label.
events: Blast debuts under a record label.
A tabloid scandal puts Nana O. and Ren in the spotlight.
Ren proposes and Nana O. accepts.

arcs.name: Fireworks
arcs.summary: The series closes by looking ahead to a future where the friends have drifted apart.
events: Nana K. runs into Shoji again.
A flash-forward shows Nana K. and her daughter while Nana O. has vanished.
The two Nanas' fireworks night together is remembered.

filler.note: No filler; the three 'Junko's Room' recaps are numbered 11.5, 21.5 and 36.5 and so sit outside the numbering, and episode 6 retells episode 1 with new scenes.
